inference: WB Class_35259f6b/Field_58d70acb/Struct_29ea5d2b/Field_808dd66c maps to primary projectile selection and resolves uniquely to PBNS object 2 Class_796b4d4a.

PBNS object 2 Class_796b4d4a inherits the Class_990616ac Field_1f7b3933 child link, which resolves to object 15 Class_9966532d. The L148 Frag result uses the same selected child member and maps the five Class_9966532d blast fields.
Object 15 directly imports ECR object 0. The WB/PBNS object trees contain no direct import to SimEx_IncendiaryFireRadius or either damage-affector root among the six scoped captures.
The selected serialized values can support a conditional source-data comparison beside Frag; no gameplay or site behavior follows from these links.
unresolved: PBNS object[2] Field_0bf4f62b=300.0 and Field_5ef7b9a1=10.0 are f32 values owned by Class_990616ac; their meanings remain unresolved in this owner context. The InitialSpeed and TimeToLive labels from a different owner context were not transferred.
Gravity and Drag are mapped on the exact Class_6761170b owner, but their units and runtime use are unresolved. The separate Struct_739f3ac5 operand was not retained in the bounded raw-check set.

The selected Class_9966532d members map to BlastDamage, BlastRadius, InnerBlastRadius, ShockwaveDamage and ShockwaveRadius. Their units, radius metric, falloff/interpolation, damage composition and runtime activation are not established.
ECR object[0] Field_39736b02, Field_77d44563 and Field_5cda5a37 are raw f32 operands; their field roles and runtime effects are unresolved.

SimEx_IncendiaryFireRadius and both damage affectors are captured candidates. Their direct links within SimEx do not connect them to the scoped WB/PBNS chain; no numeric values from those candidates are assigned to the grenade.
Serialized imports and field values do not establish native activation, damage application or in-game behavior.
siteImpact: The selected Incendiary Grenade blast child stores mapped BlastDamage 0 and BlastRadius 4. The inspected WB/PBNS trees do not directly select the separate fire-radius expression or damage affectors, so this trace cannot supply an incendiary fire-damage or coverage comparison. No Analyzer product change is proposed.
